# llms.txt — Vesk framework

> Machine-oriented reference for LLM agents. Covers the whole framework;
> per-package detail lives in each package's `llms.txt`. Verified against
> source at commit 2a5b19d.

## What Vesk is

A compiler-first framework for the post-VDOM web. `.vsk` is a TypeScript
superset adding `component` declarations, `track()`-based reactivity,
islands, and statement-mode component bodies. No virtual DOM: the compiler
emits per-cell DOM updates and static subtrees need no hydration runtime.

## Where everything is

- Human/agent docs: `docu/` (language, compiler, runtime, CLI) — every
  page verified against source with a "Verified against:" footer.
- `packages/cli/llms.txt` — CLI reference (commands, config loading,
  dev-server flow).
- `docs/haul.md` — the native Go haul engine.
- `AGENTS.md` (root + per-package) — conventions and hard rules.

## Key facts

- **Grammar**: `component Name(params) {}`, `async component`,
  `export [default] [async] component`, `client` island modifier,
  generics supported. `component` is reserved.
- **Tracked state**: `const &[count] = track(0)` / `&[count, rawCell]`.
  Runtime exports `track, get, set, untrack, peek, derived, effect,
  flushSync, tick, on_destroy, createContext, pre_effect` etc.
- **Body modes**: expression mode (`return <jsx>`) and statement mode
  (bare JSX, `if`/`for`/`while`/`switch`/`try`, guard clauses, key/index
  clauses, `empty {}` alternates). Both are first-class — features and
  tests must cover both.
- **Boundary**: `client` components are islands (render on server and
  client). `{#server}` renders SSR-only; `{#client}` is SSR-stripped,
  kept in the client bundle. A `client` component cannot contain
  `{#server}` and vice versa (compile error).
- **SSR**: event-handler attributes (`on*`) are excluded from SSR HTML
  entirely. Dynamic text is escaped (`escapeHtml`).
- **Hydration**: server emits `<!--vsk-->` markers before non-static
  subtrees; client claims existing DOM via a walker
  (`hydrate`, `hydrateViewport`, `hydrateIdle`, `hydrateOnInteraction`,
  `needsHydration`, `hydrationCount`, `hydrateInitial`).
- **Reactivity scheduler**: microtask-batched; `flushSync(fn)` for
  synchronous mode; `tick()` resolves on the next animation frame;
  max 1001 flush rounds ("Maximum update depth exceeded").
- **Negative facts**: `batch` does NOT exist (use `flushSync`). No VDOM.
  No `suspense` implementation. No `vite-plugin-vesk`. `track.ts` in the
  runtime is dead code — never import it.

## Packages

| Package | Surface |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/compiler` | `@vesk/compiler` — preprocess/parser/IR/codegen, exports `parse`, `createBaseParser`, `VeskParserPlugin`, `generateIR`, `render` (server codegen), `compileClient`/`compile`, `isStaticIR`, `defineConfig`, `definePlugin`, `preset`, `validateConfig`, `scanRoutes`, `scanComponents`, `collectSources`, `matchUrl`, plus `typecheckProject` (via `src/typecheck`) |
| `packages/runtime` | `@vesk/runtime` — client barrel `index-client`, server barrel `index-server` (split: hydrators/bindings client-only; request/ISR server-only). Subpath exports: `@vesk/runtime/router` (full routing surface + LoadingIndicator), `@vesk/runtime/server` (request/response primitives) |
| `packages/adapter` | build output (platforms: node/vercel/netlify/cloudflare/deno/aws/edge/coxmos), dev server, prod server, SSR function, SEO audit |
| `packages/cli` | `vesk` binary — dev/build/start/typecheck/seo |
| `packages/haul` + `@vesk/haul-<os>-<cpu>` | native Go engine: build/dev/start/seo; typecheck via Node sidecar (JSON-RPC to `@vesk/compiler`) |
| `packages/lsp`, `prettier-plugin`, `plugin-tailwind`, `create-vesk` | tooling |

## Router surface (`@vesk/runtime/router`)

- `useRouter()`: `push`, `replace`, `back`, `forward`, `go(n)`, `refresh`,
  `prefetch`, `beforeEach`, `isLoading`, `progress` (0-100), `error`,
  `pathname`, `params`, `search`, `setSearch`, `route`, `canGoBack`.
- `beforeEach(fn)`: sync guards return `false` (block) or `string`
  (redirect). Async guards return a Promise. Returns unsubscribe fn.
- Router options: `viewTransitions: boolean` wraps DOM swap in
  `document.startViewTransition` when available.
- Navigate is sync for sync guards (backward-compatible); async only
  when a guard returns a Promise.
- `scrollToHash()` called after every render for anchor restoration.

## Rules for agents

- Every compiler source edit needs a rebuild:
  `npx tsx packages/cli/src/build-packages.ts`.
- Tests: `npx tsx packages/compiler/src/<file>.test.ts`; full suite
  `node scripts/test.js`; hydration paths: `node hydration-test.mjs`.
- No regex for source parsing anywhere in compiler/haul (AST/tokenizer
  only). No `batch` imports.
- Docs edits: follow `docu/` conventions (verify against source, both
  body modes, "Verified against:" footers).
